For Respondent(s) : Mr. Mohd. Javed, Pp.
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Arun Monga
Order 15/07/2024

1. Petitioners are before this Court seeking quashing of an Fir No.69/2024, dated 07.06.2024,
registered under Sections 376 (2) (N) of Ipc and 4 & 6 of Pocso Act, at Police Station Bhupalsagar,
District Chittorgarh.

2. At the outset, learned counsel for the petitioners submits that they have entered into a
compromise in the Panchayat of their village, therefore, he is under instructions to withdraw the
instant petition to seek legal remedy, which may otherwise be available in accordance with law, at
appropriate stage before the competent Court.

2.  Further, he submits that the petitioners may also be given liberty to raise their defence, as raised herein, before the appropriate forum in accordance with law.
3. May do so.
4. Dismissed with liberty as aforesaid.
(ARUN MONGA),J 47-/Jitender//-
